description: CKEditor plugin for blockquote functionality, including toggling blockquote formatting and handling selection changes.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Determines if the current selection is within a blockquote, returning CKEDITOR.TRISTATE_ON or CKEDITOR.TRISTATE_OFF.

methods.name: onSelectionChange
methods.description: Updates the blockquote command state based on current selection.

methods.name: noBlockLeft
methods.description: Checks if a blockquote element has any block boundary children.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the toggle blockquote command, handling both applying and removing blockquote formatting.
